title: AH It's Coming Out (Golden Freddy)
blurb: Some remixes could only have come from the FNAF fandom, and this is one of them: the panicked 'AH, IT'S COMING OUT' clip welded onto Golden Freddy, the series' most unexplained animatronic. The result is startling and completely unserious at the same time, which is roughly the fandom's entire creative output described in one sentence. Golden Freddy has always been the hollow one, the one who appears when nothing triggered him — pairing that with a chaotic scream is either sacrilege or perfect. Play it when something appears that had no business appearing.
origin: A FNAF fandom remix combining Golden Freddy with a viral panic clip.
